exposure: diagnosis of a chronic mental disorder
diagnosis of a chronic somatic disorder
diagnosis of a chronic severe neurocognitive disorder in the infant
cohort: The study included all 6,897,384 infants born alive in France between 2010 and 2019, identified from the Mother-Child EPI-MERES nationwide register.
finding: Strong independent risk factors for early child physical abuse (before age 1) include maternal low financial resources, young maternal age, substance use disorders, intimate partner violence, maternal mental or somatic disorders, hospitalisation for a mental disorder, very preterm birth, and infant chronic severe neurocognitive disorder.
